result.summary: Found 1 minor visual/content issue with an invalid discount badge display.

issues.description: A '-0%' discount badge is displayed on the bottom pizza restaurant card, which is an invalid, nonsensical discount value that appears visually broken and confusing to users.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge entirely if no active discount applies to this restaurant, or replace the '-0%' value with a valid positive discount percentage if a discount is intended.
